response.query: Generate a scintific personality traits description of this real-world scientist : Renowned researcher Dr. Xiaodong Xu leads top research on low-frequency noise in charge-density-wave nanowires. His work is highly cited in the field.
response.answer: Dr. Xiaodong Xu is a highly cited researcher known for his pioneering work on low-frequency noise in charge-density-wave nanowires. His contributions have significantly advanced the field. His scientific rigor and innovative research are widely recognized.
